sources.producer: CSU Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab
sources.limitations: Original grids are inspected for measured coverage only. NAVD88 elevations need a reviewed local chart-datum transformation before any depth gate. Rough terrain codes are not independent rock samples. Per-cell uncertainty, hazards, protected areas and local fishing rules remain to be reconciled; no public target or export is supported yet.

sources.producer: CSU Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab
sources.limitations: Original grids were inspected, but NAVD88 elevations are not qualified MLLW fishing depths. The habitat grid codes rough versus smooth terrain inferred from bathymetry, not sampled rock. The metadata's positional/vertical accuracy statements vary with depth and are not per-cell product uncertainty. No target or export may be generated from this source until datum, substrate, hazards and complete legal geometry are reviewed.
